findings.title: PHP 'PHP2Shell' RCE
findings.summary: Two critical vulnerabilities in PHP allow unauthenticated remote code execution via memory corruption and stale global state.

findings.title: GitLab RCE (CVE-2026-97229)
findings.summary: An integer overflow in regular expression validation allows unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server.

findings.title: WordPress Core RCE (CVE-2026-119977)
findings.summary: Predictable staging paths used during core upgrades allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

findings.title: Android Remote Code Execution Flaws
findings.summary: Multiple memory safety vulnerabilities in Android allow for remote code execution without user interaction.

findings.title: Google Chrome Use-After-Free (CVE-2026-118306)
findings.summary: A critical use-after-free vulnerability in the FileSystem component of Google Chrome allows remote code execution outside the sandbox.

findings.title: Linux Kernel TCP Use-After-Free
findings.summary: A vulnerability in the Linux kernel's TCP stack allows for potential memory corruption during SYN request processing.

findings.title: Zyxel GS1900 Series Out-of-Bounds Write
findings.summary: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the CGI program of Zyxel GS1900 switches allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute OS commands.

findings.title: Barracuda ESG and ADC Root Access Chain
findings.affected_technology: Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG) and Load Balancer ADC
findings.summary: A combination of an authentication bypass and a command injection flaw allows attackers to gain root access to Barracuda appliances.

findings.title: Android SMS 'of Death' DoS
findings.summary: An integer overflow in the WAP PDU decoding process allows a remote attacker to crash unpatched phones via SMS.
